html:
.workspace {
  height: 880px;
  border-radius: var(--canvas-node-radius);
}
.fill {
  --canvas-min-height: 0px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  height: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
}
.fill > .workspace {
  flex: 1;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  border: 0;
}
.fill .canvasRegion,
.fill .canvasSurface {
  min-height: 0;
}
.projectFill {
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  gap: 8px;
}
.projectFill > .actions,
.projectFill > p {
  padding: 0 12px;
}
.projectFill > .actions {
  padding-top: 8px;
}
.palette,
.stack,
.form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.palette {
  padding: 12px;
}
.field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.field > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.field select,
.builder select,
.field textarea,
.json {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: var(--background);
  color: var(--foreground);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.field textarea {
  min-height: 80px;
  resize: vertical;
}
.builder select:focus-visible,
.field select:focus-visible,
.field textarea:focus-visible,
.json:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.field [aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--destructive);
}
.field :disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
}
.list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.paletteItem {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  text-align: left;
}
.paletteItem > span {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.paletteItem small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.muted {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.error {
  color: var(--destructive);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.toolbar > span {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.sidebarFull {
  display: block;
}
.sidebarSmall {
  display: none;
  padding: 4px;
}
.navigation {
  padding: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.navigation .field {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.nodeLink {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 32px;
  width: 100%;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: left;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}
.nodeLink:hover {
  background: var(--muted);
}
.nodeLink[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}
.bottom {
  padding: 4px 12px 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.bottom[data-collapsed="true"] {
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.bottomTabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.bottomToggle {
  margin-left: auto;
}
.bottomFeedback {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.bottomBody {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.bottom h3 {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.bottom ul {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.dialog {
  max-height: min(80dvh, 720px);
  overflow: auto;
}
.json {
  min-height: 240px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  resize: vertical;
}
.shortcut {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
@container workspace-navigation (max-width: 100px) {
  .sidebarFull {
    display: none;
  }
  .sidebarSmall {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .field select,
  .field textarea,
  .nodeLink {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .workspace {
    height: 1000px;
  }
  .toolbar {
    gap: 8px;
  }
}

.canvasRegion {
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 360px;
}
.canvasRegion > div {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.canvasSurface {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 360px;
}

.execution {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.execution > div:last-of-type {
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
}
.output {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow: auto;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  padding: 8px;
  background: var(--surface-raised);
}
.actions select {
  height: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--foreground);
  padding: 0 8px;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .actions select {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}
.builder {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 8px;
}
.builder legend {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.builder label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.builder input[type="checkbox"] {
  min-width: 16px;
  min-height: 16px;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .builder input[type="checkbox"] {
    min-width: 44px;
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}

.execution summary {
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.execution summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .execution summary,
  .builder select {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}

.canvasRegion {
  position: relative;
}
.canvasRegion > .layoutNotice {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 20;
  top: 12px;
  left: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  height: auto;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
